preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and n > 61 and n < 10**6 for n in input_numbers)
preconditions.description: All input numbers must be odd integers greater than 61 and less than 10^6.
The number of input lines must not exceed 1000.
The last input number must be 0, indicating the end of input.

postconditions.expression: all((p1 + p2**2 + p3**3 == n) for n, (p1, p2, p3) in zip(input_numbers, output_triplets))
postconditions.description: For each input number, the output triplet must satisfy the equation P1 + P2^2 + P3^3 = n.

postconditions.expression: all((p1 > 1 and p2 > 1 and p3 > 1) for (p1, p2, p3) in output_triplets)
postconditions.description: All output primes must be greater than 1.

postconditions.expression: any((p1, p2, p3) == (0, 0, 0) for (p1, p2, p3) in output_triplets)
postconditions.description: If no valid triplet exists for an input number, the output must be '0 0 0'.
